title: Pacts and loyalty
kicker: Roster and summoning · summon and fusion
hook: **Pacts** bind demons to contract slots. Keep **loyalty** up — neglect a bound demon long enough and it **refuses to deploy**.

blindSpots.meaning: A contract slot that binds a specimen for field work. Opened with `P` on the rail.
How willing that bound demon is to keep working for you. It decays under daily upkeep if you ignore the pact.
The demon stays in the roster but will not go to the lawn (or other field work) until loyalty is healthy again.
Assigned to a pact slot. Bound demons are the ones you field; spare unbound ones can still sit on expeditions.

alsoTrue: Tribute is part of keeping a pact paid — see [tribute](tribute).
Deploy detail for the lawn: [bound demon deploy](lawn-deploy).

sections.title: What it is
paras: Binding is how a specimen becomes someone you can count on in a fight.
Loyalty is the trust meter on that bond — not a second health bar.

sections.title: How you use it
steps: Assign a demon to a contract slot.
Watch loyalty and pay what the pact asks (including tribute).
Deploy bound demons when the lawn or other field work needs them.
diagram: specimen  ->  pact slot  ->  loyalty healthy  ->  can deploy

sections.title: Why it exists
paras: Without loyalty, the roster is a free storage chest.
With it, binding is a relationship you maintain — not a one-click permanent buff.

doSteps: Open Pacts when the layer is unlocked (a contract has been offered).
Bind one demon you actually want on the lawn.
Note loyalty and any tribute ask before you walk away for a long time.
doNote: Stop when “refuse to deploy” is clear. Pay next: [tribute](tribute).

mixUps.q: Did my demon get deleted when loyalty dropped?
mixUps.a: No. It refuses to deploy. Fix the pact; the specimen is still yours.
Spare demons can still go on expeditions. Lawn deploy wants a healthy bound pact.

mixUps.q: Is loyalty the same as tribute?
mixUps.a: No. Loyalty is willingness. Tribute is the payment side of the contract — see [tribute](tribute).
Only as many as you need in the field. Duplicates and spares have other jobs (fusion, expeditions).
